name: com.unity.2d.radiancecascades
description: EXPERIMENTAL. This is not an official Unity package and is not supported by Unity. It is an experiment in screen-space global illumination for the URP 2D Renderer using radiance cascades, and it may change or disappear without notice.

samples.description: A controlled scene for judging the lighting: one bright emitter and a few solid occluders, with a probe that reads the lit result back and reports it.
